WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS baseline_length
  FROM rating_averages
), above_baseline AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length, b.baseline_length
  FROM rating_averages ra
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ra.avg_length > b.baseline_length
), kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_length
  FROM above_baseline
), remaining AS (
  SELECT ab.avg_length, ab.baseline_length, km.mean_length
  FROM above_baseline ab
  CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
  WHERE ab.avg_length > km.mean_length
)
SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_avg_length,
       AVG(avg_length - baseline_length) AS mean_excess_over_baseline,
       AVG(avg_length - mean_length) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean
FROM remaining

assumptions.assumption: Ratings with no non-NULL film lengths are excluded from the per-rating averages and all subsequent means.
